library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise org.springframework.modulith.events.jpa.JpaEventPublicationRepository, JpaEventPublicationRepository$JpaEventPublicationAdapter, JpaEventPublicationConfiguration/JpaEventPublicationAutoConfiguration, and the archiving/updating subpackages (ArchivingAutoConfiguration, ArchivedJpaEventPublication, DefaultJpaEventPublication) by wiring a minimal JPA EntityManagerFactory backed by an in-memory HSQLDB connection (e.g. jdbc:hsqldb:mem:<name>) through Spring's ApplicationContextRunner or @DataJpaTest, letting Hibernate create the schema automatically (no bundled SQL scripts ship in the jar, so rely on hbm2ddl auto-create). No environment variables, system properties, or external services are required beyond this in-memory setup.
risks: Native-image reflection/proxy metadata for Hibernate's generated entity proxies and JPA metamodel will only be captured by the tracing agent if the generated tests actually persist and query JpaEventPublication/ArchivedJpaEventPublication entities end-to-end; a shallow test that only instantiates classes without hitting the EntityManager will under-report metadata.

spring-boot-hibernate is pinned to 4.1.0 (hibernate-core 7.4.1.Final) specifically to match spring-modulith-events-jpa 2.1.0's own optional dependency version; this pairing should be revisited if a newer spring-modulith version is requested later.
